editorial:
Imagine losing your wife and spending every waking second trying to find the person who did it. That is exactly where you start with Hsiang Ming. He is a man driven by pure grief and anger, but as he closes in on the killer, things get weird. You expect a typical revenge story, but you quickly find out that the killer is not the monster you thought he was. The vibe is gritty and tense, making you feel like you are right there in the streets with him while the plot shifts in directions you will not see coming.

The acting is solid and the action scenes hit hard without feeling too over the top. You will love how the story flips the script on you, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. If you enjoy old-school crime thrillers with a lot of heart, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older gem, you might want to hunt for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just look for a high-def rental on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: The final act reveals that the real villains are the people Hsiang Ming trusted. The man he thought was a monster was actually a victim of a larger conspiracy. In a big showdown, Hsiang Ming has to team up with his former enemy to take down the corrupt officials who orchestrated the murder. It all ends with a violent clash where the bad guys finally get what they deserve, giving Hsiang Ming some peace at last.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s crime dramas and revenge plots with a twist.
